name: Emergency Housing
description: Emergency Housing provides grants to clients who have an immediate emergency housing need and cannot access other adequate accommodation.

attributes.summary: A grant product providing short-term emergency accommodation funding for clients with an immediate housing need, subject to income/asset limits, client responsibilities, and supplier standards.
attributes.eligibility: Subject to income and cash asset limits, residence criteria. Covers actual and reasonable costs for emergency housing with security deposit grant included.
attributes.payment_details: Emergency housing contribution calculated based on net weekly income and Jobseeker Support rates. Payments made to opted-in or non-opted-in suppliers meeting emergency housing supplier standards. Longer grant periods available during low availability, pandemic, natural disaster or other emergency event.
attributes.obligations: Clients must pay emergency housing contribution, make reasonable efforts to obtain other housing, and engage with support services.
attributes.stand_down: 13-week non-entitlement period applies for clients who fail to meet responsibilities, with limited circumstances exceptions.
attributes.income_test: Income limits and cash asset limits apply. Emergency housing contribution calculated based on net weekly income.
